faq.title: FAQ
faq.sub: Common questions from school leaders and HR teams.

items.q: Can we use our existing rubric?
items.a: Yes. Start from templates or bring your rubric structure and scoring bands. You can version by cycle.

items.q: Does this work for non-teaching staff?
items.a: Absolutely. Build role-based rubrics for counselors, administrators, and support teams.

items.q: Can principals manage their area while HR oversees everything?
items.a: Yes. Delegate area-level administration while HR maintains policies and oversight.

items.q: What about coaching and improvement plans?
items.a: Evaluations can produce structured growth plans with goals, action steps, and follow-ups.
